name: minimax-video
description: MiniMax video: H3 text/image/reference to video (V2) and Hailuo 2.3 (V1) as polled tasks with downloads, task status and file retrieval

nodes.title: Generate video (H3)
nodes.description: Text, image (first/last frame) or reference to video with MiniMax-H3 models (paid per second; waits and saves the video)

content.description: One text item plus optional media, e.g. [{"type":"text","text":"..."}] or add {"type":"image_url","image_url":{"url":"https://..."},"role":"first_frame"} (roles: first_frame, last_frame, reference_image, reference_video, reference_audio)

ratio.description: Required for text to video (not adaptive); image to video always uses the image's ratio

wait.description: Wait for the job to finish (default true); false returns the job id at once

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Generate video (H3) with callback

content.description: One text item plus optional media, e.g. [{"type":"text","text":"..."}] or add {"type":"image_url","image_url":{"url":"https://..."},"role":"first_frame"} (roles: first_frame, last_frame, reference_image, reference_video, reference_audio)

ratio.description: Required for text to video (not adaptive); image to video always uses the image's ratio

callback_url.description: URL MiniMax notifies on status changes

wait.description: Wait for the job to finish (default true); false returns the job id at once

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
